goals.title: A boatful of friends who won't sit still
goals.pitch: Paddle a boat you carved across the bay, full of friends who won't sit still.
goals.play: The friends are the cargo and they are alive: each has its own weight and its own mind, and the boat answers every move they make. Pinchy lunges at every fish, Cumulus dozes and slumps over the side, two friends who quarrel won't sit together, and a jumping fish makes everyone rush to one side. You paddle, steer and call them back across the boat when it leans, while the waves rock it, and the hull you carved decides how much it forgives: wide and low shrugs off a rush, narrow and fast tips at a sneeze. You carve with the waterline drawn live on the hull, seat the friends where their weight helps, and set out; every crossing is a new mix of friends, sea and mood, so no two go the same way.
goals.moment: Halfway across, a fish jumps on the left; every friend rushes to look, the boat rolls over, and they all bob up around it, Pinchy still holding the fish.
road: three carved hulls in the bay, buoyancy and roll from their own meshes (displaced volume each frame): upright, listing, capsizing (film)
friends as moving loads: they climb in, shift and lean, and the boat answers each one (film of a rush to one side)
Lumi paddles and steers it in Jump in, and calls friends to the other side
carving the hull in Jump in with the waterline shown live
the friends' own minds aboard (fish, naps, quarrels) and the day's waves (WaveSpec)

goals.title: Dam the stream, then let it go
goals.pitch: Dam the stream with stones and clay, then pull the last stone and send the flood down the island.
goals.play: You carry stones from the beach and clay from the bank and pile them across the stream by hand, and the water answers every stone: it rises, finds the gaps and spurts through them, so you press clay into the leaks while it climbs. A taller dam holds more water and pushes harder on the wall, so you build it thick at the bottom or it bulges and fails early. The full pond is yours to spend: pull the last stone and the flood you stored rushes down the island, as big as the dam you built. It turns the mill, washes the sand into the shapes it carves, floats your boat down to the sea, or flattens the friends' sandcastles; then you build again, bigger.
goals.moment: Lumi pulls the last stone; the pond pours through, and the wave carries the boat with all the friends down the stream and out into the sea.
road: shallow water on the GPU over the island's own heightfield: the stream, a heap of stones, the water rising and seeping through the gaps (film)
stones and clay placed by hand in Jump in, the water answering each one
the dam's load: stones in the wall slide when the water pushes harder than their friction holds (rigid stones, no crack model)
pull the last stone: the stored flood runs down the island and carves the sand
the flood does work: the mill turns, a boat rides it to the sea
